confirmedFindings.title: TOCTOU race condition between file access check and subsequent write
confirmedFindings.body: Checking file existence with fs.access before fs.writeFile introduces a TOCTOU race condition. A local attacker can create a symlink between the check and write.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Use fs.writeFile with { flag: "wx", mode: 0o600 } to atomically create and write the file without preceding access check.
